label: GSoC
name: Google Summer of Code
description: Mentored open source projects with participating organizations worldwide.
coverage: 2009–2015 community-mirrored project records and 2016–2026 GSoC Organizations snapshots. Early years include organizations with indexed projects; original Melange links may redirect.

label: LFX
name: LFX Mentorship
description: Linux Foundation mentorships across open source ecosystems.
coverage: CNCF mentorship projects for 2019–2026, by cohort. Includes the 2019–2020 CommunityBridge predecessor and the 2026 Term 3 export; other Linux Foundation ecosystems are not yet covered.

label: SoB
name: Summer of Bitcoin
description: Mentored Bitcoin open source development and design projects.
coverage: Historical organizations and projects from the MIT-licensed SoB Organizations snapshot; current participation must be checked at the official source.

label: ESoC
name: European Summer of Code
description: Mentored open source and applied AI projects connected with European hubs.
coverage: All 11 opportunity cards in the reviewed official 2026 README, grouped by organization. Idea lists are not accepted-project counts.

label: Outreachy
name: Outreachy
description: Remote open source internships supporting people who face underrepresentation and systemic bias.
coverage: Public participating-community and project-title archives from May 2020 through May 2026. Private project details are not collected; December 2026 is not included.

label: C4GT
name: Code for Good Tech
description: Mentoring and contributions to digital public goods and technology for social impact.
coverage: 105 listed projects in the official Dedicated Mentoring Program 2025 archive. Current 2026 and ongoing Community opportunities are on Badal and are not claimed as covered.

label: SoK
name: Season of KDE
description: Mentored contributions across the KDE free software community.
coverage: KDE's published 2025 selected-project announcement, with nine project summaries. KDE is one community hosting multiple projects; 2026 is not included.
